_meta.description: Town XP a building restyle grants, keyed "<buildingTypeId>/<level>/<styleId>". MEASURED from 124 captured POST .../towns/current/buildings/{id}/styles/{id} calls: every one moved town.levelInfo.experiencePoints, the amount depends only on these three keys, and the same change pays the same in both directions. Used in preference to building_upgrades.json styleInputs[].prestigeForLevel, which is exact for the TownHall but high by a fixed 65 for walls and 115 for the main gate. Regenerate with script/extract_journey_fixtures.py.
